jobs.prompt: Two fixes for the claude shell pause (tools/claude-shell.mjs claudeShellPausedProblem and resolveWorkerKey). (1) tools/lanes.mjs: resolveLanes rejects the machine setting lanes.claude.shellPaused with lanes-invalid unknown field, which stops every run; accept shellPaused (must be true or false, validated like the paused field) in the claude lane fields. Test: resolveLanes with that setting true and false works, and a non-boolean value is refused. (2) tools/swarm/core-32.mjs line ~28 workerKeyGuard only reads the worker key to scan run output for leaks and must keep working while the lane is paused: split an internal exported readWorkerKey in tools/claude-shell.mjs with NO pause check (same env-then-keychain read, same shape check); keep resolveWorkerKey (with the pause check, calling readWorkerKey) for dispatch only; use readWorkerKey in workerKeyGuard. Test: with the anthropic lane paused, workerKeyGuard still resolves the key through an injected exec while resolveWorkerKey refuses. Build fake key values at run time (repeat a short string), no credential-looking literals, never read the real keychain (inject exec). STANDING TEST RULE: per-test timeout at most 60 s. New tests go in tests/claude-shell-paused-lanes.test.mjs.
